title: アルゴリズムとデータ構造
subtitle: Algorithms and Data Structure
teachers:
SAITO Masashi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
This course is for an educational goal to acquire Information design basic ability.
Students will:
(1)　acquire the basic algorithmic thinking ability to fuse and utilize　management and IT,
(2)　learn the fundamental algorithms which are useful to solve several problems,
(3)　acquire the ability to devise solutions for management organizations aim.
advice:
There is a need for managers and business promoters who understand IT in these days, so that various management functions and IT application systems should be vital for students who are willing to become modern business persons.
Up to now, students have learned web page creation method, IT system basics that enable IT passport acquisition, database construction techniques, hands-on efforts such as dynamic web page creation, and programming with Python. To understand the IT technology used in actual business from a bird's-eye view, it is necessary to solve problems rather than using individual applications. So students should understand algorithms that are methods and means to solve them.
The purpose of this class is to learn the outline of more than a dozen types of algorithms and to acquire the ability to solve problems using algorithms. Specifically, learning of the following ten algorithms that students normally use in an invisible form, they will deepen understanding through the proposal of practical solutions.
(1) Sort, (2) Recursion, (3) Quick sort, (4) Hash table, (5) Breadth-first search, (6) Dijkstra method, (7) Greedy algorithm, (8) Dynamic programming, (9) k-neighbors, (10) cryptography.
One of the purposes of this class is “deeply think about the answer by yourself”, so that students will have a simple assignment at each lecture. In addition, lectures will be held by using Python, students can learn by executing some actual programs.
books: Grokking Algorithms: An illustrated guide for programmers and other curious people, Manning Publications, Manning Publications; ISBN 978-1617292231
requiredKnowledge: It is necessary to have a certain level of knowledge about general corporate management and information technology by taking other subjects: Web design, IT system management, database management, programming basics, applied programming.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand and explain information technology in general by learning basic knowledge of IT.
Be able to explain necessity and effectiveness of algorithms used in various information systems.
Be able to explain algorithms being important means and subject of corporate strategies.
Be able to devise and design algorithms to solve problems by yourselves.
